en: A black and white vintage postcard. The front side features a wide view of a town with a prominent church (with a tower) in the foreground, some industrial buildings, lots of smoke coming from the factories, water, and wooded hills in the background. Printed at the bottom: 'TIMRÅ KYRKA. SKÖNVIKS SÅG OCH KOLGÅRD.' On the back, the text and format are characteristic of an early 20th-century European postcard, mostly written in Swedish.
